_note: Episode 4 version 2, drawn the way of the model episode (ep01v2): every still is one full painted picture in the Bakunawa look (the JSON prompt of pipeline/draw_pick.py, one request at a time, three draws a still, the choice at 3x on every hand, face and dog; 'rNcM' = round N with new words, seed M). Sizes, angles and moves follow the Camera column of shots.md (pipeline/CAMERA.md); rows 6, 10, 19, 22, 28, 30 and 45 have a second still (bk_06b, bk_10b, bk_19b, bk_22b, bk_28b, bk_30b, bk_45b) for their later beat, so no still holds much past 6 s without a move. Central's rule of 16 Nov (CAMERA.md 6a): no cross-dissolve between two stills that both show people, so the curator's 'in: dissolve' on rows 4 and 24 is a plain cut. The markers of bk_44, bk_45 and bk_45b are also painted plain; bk_17 had a small ribbon end at the young dog's neck painted out in code. Sentence numbers are those of the current sentences.json (113 sentences); v2_04/shot_to_keys.json maps each shots.md row to its keys. Silent rows 12 and 13 are keys 120 and 121, shown inside the storyteller's line of row 11 after the chase; silent row 35 (the boy's chin) is key 122, shown on 'Tingnan mo.' (last line of row 34). Writing added in code after the choice: bk_04 BUKO PIE on the stall sign (sign_text.py); bk_45 Lola's message bubble with the exact words of her text (the three quoted sentences); bk_46 the question (last sentence) over the empty gate. The markers of bk_07/bk_08 stay unreadable (scribble repainted as plain engraved lines). Shot 47 is the trivia card (existing layout, no still). In 1869 Indio wears a sleeveless brown jacket with a front pocket over his baro: the pie of today travels in that pocket.
